name: Laifual
name_zh: 浙江来福谐波传动股份有限公司
summary: Laifual develops and manufactures harmonic reducers and integrated robot joint modules. Its joint-module range includes AC high-voltage and DC low-voltage families that combine reduction gearing, motors and position feedback for industrial and articulated robotic mechanisms.
